# Two Bit Digital

> Two Bit Digital is a UK-registered SaaS development and AI engineering studio that builds mission-critical digital systems for enterprises, government bodies, and regulated markets across the UK, United States, Australia, and Pakistan.

Two Bit Digital Ltd is incorporated in England and Wales (Companies House registration number 14710072). The company is a UN Marketplace registered vendor (vendor ID 1177996), Dun & Bradstreet D-U-N-S verified (77-532-7428), and registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (CUIN 0250598).

The studio is founded and led by Muhammad Wasif (Founder & CEO). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammadwasiftbd/

## Core Services

- [AI Integration & Automation](/services/ai-integration): LLM integration, RAG systems, document intelligence, AI agent workflows, and custom NLP pipelines for regulated industries.
- [SaaS Platform Development](/services/saas-development): End-to-end SaaS builds — multi-tenant architecture, auth, RBAC, billing, analytics, and API design.
- [Web & App Development](/services/web-app-development): Full-stack web applications and React Native mobile apps built on Next.js 14 and TypeScript.
- [Compliance & RegTech](/services/compliance-regtech): CPR-compliant legal case management, cryptographic audit trails, zero-knowledge document storage, and regulatory workflow systems.
- [Government & Public Sector Digital](/services/government-digital): Digital delivery for government bodies — GDS-aligned citizen portals, case management, and procurement framework bids (G-Cloud, Crown Commercial Service, DOS).
- [Cloud & Infrastructure](/services/cloud-infrastructure): AWS and Vercel cloud architecture, CI/CD pipelines, serverless deployments, and observability.

## In-House Products

- [Tikkit X](https://tikkitx.com): Live mobile-first event ticketing and management platform with offline-capable HMAC-SHA256/HKDF cryptographic QR verification. Operates in Pakistan. Supports JazzCash and EasyPaisa payments. Free to start.
- [Averon Legal Systems](/products/averon-legal-systems): CPR Part 47 and Part 36 case management SaaS for UK costs lawyers. Role-based dashboards, automated deadline alerting, document management, and client portal. Currently in closed beta.
- [Terra Core](/products/terra-core): Compliance-first document intelligence engine with AES-256 zero-knowledge encryption and cryptographically chained audit logs. In development.

## Legal Technology Solutions

Two Bit Digital builds end-to-end digital solutions for law firms, covering both client-facing and internal management layers.

Client-facing: Professional law firm websites, client portals with case diary access, secure document sharing, consultation booking, judgements libraries, and online case search.

Internal management: Matter lifecycle tracking, CPR procedural deadline engines, document management with role-based access, case file digitisation, employee and team management, time recording, and tamper-evident audit trails.

Live example: YKC Legal (ykclegal.org) — a 75-year-old Pakistani law firm for whom Two Bit Digital built a complete digital presence including website, client portal, case search, judgements repository, and consultation booking.

## Case Studies

- [CPR Costs Management SaaS](/work): 14-week build of a multi-tenant legal SaaS — 94% reduction in missed deadlines, 12 firms at beta launch.
- [Event Ticketing Platform](/work): Offline-capable cryptographic QR ticketing with 100% fraud prevention at entry.
- [AI Document Intelligence for Financial Services](/work): RAG-based compliance document processor — 68% analyst time reduction, 97.3% accuracy.
- [Government Citizen Portal](/work): WCAG 2.2 AA citizen services portal — form abandonment dropped from 40% to 11%.
- [Cryptographic Audit Trail System](/work): FCA examination-ready audit log — 2.3M events chained, no examination findings.
